effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by 1000 points. You can also Special Summon up to 2 "Nimble Momonga" cards from your Deck to your side of the field in face-down Defence Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: the modern script only offers the optional Special Summon prompt when a copy is actually in the Deck (`if #g>0 and Duel.SelectYesNo(...)`), whereas the goat script offers the prompt unconditionally and, when the player accepts with no copy left, reveals the Deck to prove it (`if #g==0 then Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`). The deck reveal is the entire behavioural difference; the LP gain and the Summon itself are identical.

review.notes: This is the one card in the batch that encodes only branch (A). I read both scripts in full: goat/c504700033.lua:21 and official/c22567609.lua:22 both have `if chk==0 then return true end` in the target function, so the mandatory TRIGGER_F's activation legality is identical and there is no relaxed activation condition to date - hence no chronology-unresolved flag. The remaining diff lines are non-behavioural: CATEGORY_SET is hint metadata, SetPossibleOperationInfo vs SetOperationInfo is chain-info hinting, IsReason(REASON_BATTLE) equals the bitmask test, and MODID/id resolve to the same 22567609. Two lineage observations recorded rather than flagged. First, the goat cdb text reads 'Defense' where lineage v1 (DB1-EN051, 2004-10-12) reads 'Defence' (packet ratio 0.9961) - an orthographic variant only. Second, the text limit 'up to 2 "Nimble Momonga"' (v1, v2 CP02-EN002 2007-02-06) becomes 'any number' at v3 (DLDI-EN002, 2009-08-01), but neither script implements a cap of 2: both do `g:Select(tp,1,ft,nil)` bounded only by free Monster Zones (goat/c504700033.lua:40, official/c22567609.lua:38). Upstream therefore does not treat that wording change as behavioural, and with a three-copy deck limit at most two copies can remain after this one is destroyed, so the printed cap could never bind. The rest of the lineage (v0 MRL-086 2002-09-16 through v5 EGO1-EN007 2021-06-17) is cosmetic PSCT/GY/LP modernisation.
